canonical_project: Digital Realty Korea ICN11 (Gurae-dong Data Center)
notes: Gurae-dong 6877-9; building permit 2021 (95,051 sqm GFA, B4/F8); construction start report rejected by Gimpo city Jul 2024 after resident opposition (EMF concerns) + developer administrative suit; project restarted May 2025 with DL E&C construction contract; ~80MW class. Status: construction resumption 2025.
